# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.0.3

## Added

- **Photos in the local editions.** The local web edition and the Mac app can keep up to three photos a day, stored only on the device. They appear in the calendar, the timeline and the photo card, and monthly `.llmedia` backups include them. **Settings → Clear local data** removes them.

## Changed

- **Import & export** is in **Settings → Data**.
- **Review:** the week picker shows the full week its numbers cover and sits on one line with the Week/Month switch; all dropdowns share one flat style.
- **Monthly reflection** uses the full card width and grows with the text.
- **Mood reason** field is taller.

## Fixed

- **The sidebar no longer scrolls away** on Week, Horizon, Timeline, Review and Habits.

## Unchanged

- Cloud edition data, sync, photos and Google Calendar; no migration.

## Roll back

Tag `v2.0.2` stays available.
